findings.body:
**Fix the lane count.**

Line 503 calls `acp` "the FOURTH lane". The documented lanes are `ai-sdk`, `claude-code` and `acp`. `LANE_IDS` in `src/driver/served-model.ts` lists the same three. The `claude-code` section says it merged two former lanes. The wording is stale.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-`src/driver/acp/` — the FOURTH lane: speak the Agent Client Protocol
+`src/driver/acp/` — the THIRD lane: speak the Agent Client Protocol
```
</details>
findings.title: Fix the lane count.

findings.body:
**Correct the stale path for the driver implementations.**

Line 77 says the three driver implementations live under `src/driver/drivers/`. This document and `src/driver/factory.ts` show them at `src/driver/ai-sdk/`, `src/driver/claude-code/` and `src/driver/acp/`. The eslint scope note then points at a directory that does not exist.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-driver implementations under `src/driver/drivers/` (in-process SDK,
-the Claude Code CLI/SDK transports, ACP) adopt vendors deliberately and are NOT covered.
+driver implementations under `src/driver/ai-sdk/`, `src/driver/claude-code/` and
+`src/driver/acp/` adopt vendors deliberately and are NOT covered.
```
</details>
findings.title: Correct the stale path for the driver implementations.

findings.body:
**Throw a structured `DispatchError('config')` for the `beforeRequest` lane mismatch.**

Line 316 throws a bare `Error`. Every other pre-dispatch refusal in this file uses `DispatchError('config', ...)`, for example `laneForRole`. The header says "Throws, never falls back." Callers that call `errorClassOf` get no `config` class for this refusal.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
   if (request.beforeRequest !== undefined && lane !== 'ai-sdk')
-    throw new Error('upload scanning requires the ai-sdk request gate');
+    throw new DispatchError(
+      'config',
+      `driver factory: beforeRequest (upload scanning) requires the 'ai-sdk' lane, but role '${request.role}' resolved to lane '${lane}'`,
+    );
```
</details>
findings.title: Throw a structured `DispatchError('config')` for the `beforeRequest` lane mismatch.

findings.body:
**Require ownership evidence before reaping a rejected run’s session.**

In `src/driver/factory.ts:409-410`, any thrown object with a string `sessionId` can trigger deletion. An injected ai-sdk provider can throw such an object before the run creates a record, so cleanup can delete an existing session instead.

Use an explicit ownership marker for rejected runs. Preserve cleanup for `SessionBoundError` and other supported fresh-session rejections.
findings.title: Require ownership evidence before reaping a rejected run’s session.
